items.title: Выбор компонентов: Carbon / Fluent2 / Spectrum
items.recommendation: Read current English agent briefs via design_rule_section: forms for textarea/select/combobox/checkbox/switch; actions for button emphasis and toolbar/menu; navigation for tabs/tree; layers for dialogs; data for table/selection; feedback for toast/messagebar/empty/skeleton/progress; icons for tooltip/help. Use design_rule_sections with RU/EN purpose queries. Each enterprise-* rule declares when/avoid/checks and real AG candidate IDs. Source conventions differ; do not assume vendor capabilities exist in AG. Offline: component-system-guidance.json. For Promise UI search async-boundary and read async-components; synchronous components need no boundary. For palette selection search palette-builder and read color-palettes; use design_palette without overriding host roles. For product/component cards and catalog search, read catalog-item-presentation and catalog-discovery; preserve the host Pinterest layout. For human-first interfaces usable by agents, read human-first-agent-interfaces and agent-interface-verification; keep native semantics and verify actual outcomes without changing host layout. For every web interface, read web-security-by-design, safe-web-content and secure-web-actions: server authorization, untrusted output and agent tools need explicit trust boundaries. For shared component data, event bus, request router or hot gestures read scoped-runtime-coordination: keep local state and explicit host authority; do not duplicate API calls or query caches. For cinematic/photo framing, discover all14profiles through design_layout_grids and read each grid-<type> chapter. For icons read grid-icon-generation and inspect grid-icon-draft; preserve recognizable host family and mandatory policies. For reusable screen structure, read atomic-design-composition: parts and whole, data fixtures and contextual impact review; preserve purpose-based names and current gates.
items.evaluation: Source-backed AG interpretation; caller checks and native/AT qualification remain separate.

items.title: Ассистенты: платформенные действия и контракты компонентов
items.recommendation: Read assistant-action-contract and native-assistant-overview, then apple-app-intents/windows-app-actions/android-app-functions/linux-assistant-interfaces as applicable, assistant-components and assistant-integration-testing. Share host commands and stable entity IDs across UI and adapters. Keep platform registration, discovery and actual task evidence separate; verify current OS/SDK/browser/assistant availability. Offline: native-assistants.en.md and assistant-platforms.json. No native adapters are included by this guidance.
items.evaluation: Dated AG interpretation of primary sources; native/assistant/AT qualification remains unknown until target tests.

items.title: GitLab/Pajamas: списки, сортировка и контекстные настройки
items.recommendation: For GitLab-like work lists, compact view settings, sorting, listbox/disclosure/popover choices read gitlab-pajamas-patterns, list-view-controls and nonmodal-popovers. Source-pinned12pattern mapping: @ag-design/rules/gitlab-patterns.json. Reuse existing AG primitives; only popover and sorting-control are new. Host owns data/routes/history/authority and palette; preserve masonry and current security/color/accessibility gates.
items.evaluation: Pinned source analysis and original AG implementation; caller evidence is not upstream AT qualification.

items.title: Поля формы в одной строке: выравнивание и перенос
items.recommendation: For inline forms, search/filter bars and settings read form-row-layout. Declare semantic rows; shared label/control/feedback tracks; comparable density; status below; responsive container stacking; hidden/closed disclosure. Inspect numeric rectangles with @ag-design/rules/form-row before images. Missing evidence is unknown. Preserve host masonry, DOM/keyboard order and current security/color/accessibility gates. Use auditInterface(root).formRows from @ag-design/components/audit for declared field groups; measure captions, controls and hints, preserve unknown and report current-policy requirementObservations.
items.evaluation: Source-backed AG interpretation; numeric geometry is caller evidence, not AT certification.

items.title: Подбор под проект
items.recommendation: Начните со сценария, платформы и существующей палитры. Сравните реальные элементы, назначение, ограничения и тестовые свидетельства; не выбирайте стиль по моде. Для PPTX/XLSX изучите artifact-format-selection и форматные главы; агенты по умолчанию получают компактные English instructions, пользователь выбираетRU/EN.
items.evaluation: AG policy interpretation; manual review, not source certification

items.title: Render-window для длинных лент и тяжёлых превью
items.recommendation: Если экран содержит длинную ленту, галерею или тяжёлые превью, рассмотрите createRenderWindow (render-window, core0.9.0+). Прочитайте компонент и раздел performance. Фабрика создаёт owned subtree; snapshot хранит ограниченное состояние без DOM, dispose освобождает RAF/таймеры/подписки/media. Защитите высоту, фокус, drag и несохранённый ввод. Для маленького статичного блока, основного текста, печати/SEO/browser Find предпочтителен eager DOM или отдельно проверенный режим. Для больших данных нужна отдельная пагинация. Не оборачивайте уже windowed элементы повторно; счётчики Node не доказывают CPU/RSS.
items.evaluation: Conditional AG engineering recommendation; browser API facts and local lifecycle policy are separate. Manual review, no performance guarantee.

items.title: Контекстная шапка окна
items.recommendation: При поддержке ОС перенесите частые действия в настоящую шапку окна. После системных кнопок — назад/вперёд и управление панелями. Название раздела или открытой сущности заменяет статичное имя приложения в рабочем заголовке. Сохраняйте отдельную идентичность приложения и browser fallback. Перед заменой подписи откройте раздел icons: icon-only — для узнаваемой команды с ясным объектом; icon+text/text — для неоднозначных действий и значимых разрешений; редкие команды — в подписанный overflow. Quiet, локализованное имя, tooltip/focus/touch и hit target сохраняются. Не скрывайте подписи автоматически ради плотности. Сначала прочитайте navigation / window-command-placement: scope важнее частоты. Копирование кода, локальный поиск и управление графиком остаются в компоненте. Переносите только однозначные команды окна/документа; проверяйте поддержку каждой команды и её состояния. После переноса всех действий удалите пустую дублирующую HTML-полосу; при сбое/reload верните fallback. Системное меню и toolbar могут иметь общую команду; это не требует второго HTML-ряда.
items.evaluation: AG policy interpretation; manual review, not source certification

items.title: Изменяемая ширина панелей
items.recommendation: Левая и правая панели изменяются за внутреннюю границу: pointer, стрелки клавиатуры, Home/End. Сохраняйте ширину, ограничивайте минимум/максимум и место контента; схлопывание не переносит панель на другую сторону.
items.evaluation: AG policy interpretation; manual review, not source certification

items.title: Понятная навигация и обратная связь
items.recommendation: Положение управляющих элементов стабильно. Показывайте текущий раздел, контекст, состояния загрузки/ошибки/пустоты. Названия действий объясняют результат; цвет не заменяет текст.
items.evaluation: AG synthesis: Lebedev supports structure/location/predictability; NN/g supports feedback. Manual review, no certification.

items.title: Цветовые профили и читаемость
items.recommendation: Каждый элемент использует семантические токены. Проверьте light/dark, типографику и реальные пары цветов. APCA имеет вес 70%, WCAG2 30% в рекомендательном балле; провал WCAG AA не усредняется до успеха.
items.evaluation: AG policy interpretation; manual review, not source certification

items.title: Сначала дизайн-система, затем продукт
items.recommendation: Новый элемент регистрируется как черновик. Сначала функциональные, клавиатурные, профильные и нагрузочные проверки с очисткой в ag-design; затем интеграция и повторные проверки в продукте для той же версии. Сохраните назначение, причины выбора, ограничения и факты использования.

items.title: Отступы и смысловые группы
items.recommendation: Близость показывает смысловые связи. Внутренний интервал меньше межгруппового. AG отправная точка 8 px внутри, 16–24 между; сначала пробел/ось, затем обоснованный разделитель.

items.title: Слои и поверхности
items.recommendation: Поверхности отражают контекст и порядок взаимодействия. AG: именованные слои content/sticky/popover/modal; проверяйте clipping, focus и наложения. Не лечите конфликт случайным ростом z-index.

items.title: Карточки для сканирования
items.recommendation: Карточка помогает сканировать сущность и открыть детали. AG task: ключ/статус → название → следующий шаг/блокировка → роль/языки. Code: имя/тип/место и реальные связи. Проверяйте длинный текст.

items.title: Оценка с покрытием и доказательствами
items.recommendation: Эвристики, сценарии и измерения дополняют друг друга. Unknown отдельно от fail/pass; N/A требует применимой причины. Показывайте coverage и critical gates рядом со score. Для презентации/Excel отдельно проверяйте данные, обоснованность выводов, реальный render/accessibility и редактирование/refresh; artifact-validation не заменяет target Office test.

items.title: Понятный журнал запросов агента
items.recommendation: Человек понимает запрос, ответ, состояние и границы полномочий. Лог связывает агента/задачу/request/response, отличает предложение, ошибку и выполнение. Полномочия человека и автоматизации показаны явно.

items.title: Async component ownership / асинхронная граница
items.recommendation: Use async-boundary/createAsyncBoundary for Promise-owned UI (core0.23.0+), not every synchronous component. Read its typed contract. Give each object/user/tenant an explicit key; load({signal,key}) returns detached same-document {element,dispose} or null. Consume signal; use a generation fence; clean partial resources before return and owned resources after return. Retain previous DOM only for same-key refresh; hosts protect dirty input. Separate loading/refreshing/empty/error/timeout/cancelled, polite status outside busy content, generic localized errors, explicit safe retry. Read .state before screenshots. Compose inside render-window’s sync factory; eviction disposes/aborts. Host owns cache, mutations, backoff, SSR and authorization. Verify out-of-order results, ignored abort, timeout, late cleanup, reentrancy, focus/locale and eviction. Defaults are configurable AG choices; native/AT and production performance remain unqualified. Read design_rule_section(section_id="async-components").
items.evaluation: Source-backed AG interpretation; lifecycle tests are separate from native/AT qualification.

items.title: Палитры из базового цвета / color harmony
items.recommendation: Read color policy first; preserve host palette and semantic roles. Use design_palette(base_color,background,foreground,color_space,harmonies,font_size,font_weight,role) for7bounded harmony candidates, an always-OKLCH tonal scale, actual text/fill/ink/nontext checks and ordered pair matrices. generatePalette is the offline equivalent; createPaletteBuilder powers the wiki. Wheel rotations are explicit AG heuristics, not a universal harmony standard. OKLCH and HSL differ; neither is RYB or Material HCT. Gray hue is undefined, base HEX stays exact, gamut reductions are flagged. Retain existing APCA70/WCAG30 ranking, signed Lc/fontGuidance/sentinel restrictions and separate AA gates. Numeric nontext3:1 covers only the named adjacent surface. Select roles, then recheck real pairs with design_contrast/design_color_scheme. No autoapply/profile writes, status-role remapping, CVD/AT/native/print or full-conformance claim. Read design_rule_section(section_id="color-palettes").
items.evaluation: Harmony heuristics and actual pair checks, not full accessibility or aesthetic certification.

items.title: Карточки и поиск: содержание без смены Pinterest
items.recommendation: Use createCatalogCard for literal decision metadata, native title/action controls and a borrowed detached media slot. The host owns resource disposal, routing and truthful fields. Map retail price/variants/review count to component version/package/platform/qualification as domain-appropriate; registered usage is not a rating. Separate listing comparison from detailed presentation. Preserve existing Pinterest/masonry natural heights, DOM order, wide board card, rail and render-window ownership; no fixed tile height/aspect ratio is imposed. Check actual platform/category media rules before publishing; they are not universal AG layout rules. Validate missing/unknown data, links/actions/alt, price variant/rating count, actual contrast, keyboard/focus/locale, narrow/text2x and disposal. Draft/library tests do not qualify consumers or imply sales/AT/native/fullWCAG outcomes. Read catalog-item-presentation and catalog-discovery; use catalog-search-controls for request receipts, not a new search engine.
items.evaluation: Conditional source-backed guidance; host layout/semantic roles/evidence remain authoritative.

items.title: Понятный человеку интерфейс доступен семантическим действиям агента
items.recommendation: Design for people first; agents use the same native semantics. Preserve human task, visible labels, palette/layout and control. Use correct native role/name/state/relationships, accessible names containing visible labels, named context for repeated actions and meaningful focus/DOM order. Never add agent instructions or hidden duplicate controls to ARIA. Keep concise status outside busy results, preserve drafts/recovery and verify observed effects rather than clicks. Optional API/MCP/WebMCP adapters share host validation/permissions/revision/outcome; page content is data, not authority. WebMCP is proposed progressive enhancement, not universal support or an installed AG runtime. Core0.26 preserves full segmented labels and fixes loading/state busy ancestry. Read agent-interface-verification; current briefs and manual/AT/color gates still apply. Read design_rule_section(section_id="human-first-agent-interfaces") and agent-interface-verification. Native-platform semantics need their own accessibility APIs; web ARIA examples are not native qualification. WebMCP is the baseline design recommendation for new websites/web systems; read webmcp-design.
items.evaluation: Source-backed principles and AG interpretation; independent scenario/AT/native/authorization boundaries remain.

items.title: WebMCP по умолчанию на этапе проектирования веб-систем
items.recommendation: For new websites/web systems, recommend WebMCP from initial architecture by default (owner AG policy), alongside human-first native UI. Map intents to a small set of task tools, choose Declarative API for suitable semantic forms and Imperative for complex state/async actions, share command/validation/permissions and visible outcomes. Feature-detect support and retain human fallback; document a concrete reason when no meaningful operation fits. Plan current-page registration/disposal, cancellation, stale results and concurrent human edits. Schemas/hints never grant authority; validate in code/server and keep page content inert. Recheck current Chrome API: proposed support is not universal; external MCP and native APIs differ. Test actual supported/unsupported browsers and observable results; this guidance adds no WebMCP runtime or fake execution evidence. Read design_rule_section(section_id="webmcp-design").
items.evaluation: Owner AG baseline design recommendation with actual support/fallback evidence; no new mandatory conformance gate or runtime claim.

items.title: Безопасность веб-интерфейса закладывается с brief
items.recommendation: Baseline for every web stage: map assets, actors, object/tenant ownership, untrusted sources and operation consequences. UI owns safe contextual output and clear accessible state; server owns authentication, per-request authorization, validation, state and session controls. Hidden/disabled buttons, schemas, client roles and quality scores are not security boundaries. Minimize secrets in URLs/storage/captures/logs; support password managers and risk-based reauthentication. Apply current applicable OWASP ASVS (stable5.0.0 checked2026-10-28) with owners and positive/negative evidence. Read safe-web-content and secure-web-actions. Preserve current brief/color/accessibility gates and WebMCP baseline. Use pass/fail/unknown/not-applicable; no certification/pentest/production claim from local UI checks. Read design_rule_section(section_id="web-security-by-design"), safe-web-content and secure-web-actions. Portable checklist: @ag-design/rules/web-security.md.
items.evaluation: Source-backed defensive guidance and AG interpretation; applicable server/browser controls need actual evidence, not automatic security certification.

items.title: Scoped шина и общий роутер для сложных UI
items.recommendation: Read event-bus-coordination, request-routing-data and realtime-ui-load; inspect event-bus/createEventBus and request-router/createRequestRouter. Use callbacks/parent state for small coupled UI; EventTarget for simple signals. createEventBus is a scoped headless bounded notification bus, not a global store/durable broker/authority. Three independent FIFO queues use AG8:4:1 fairness, not strict next-first or preemption; caps1024/tier, max256events/4ms cooperative flush, TTL5000ms at drain. Explicit coalesceKey only for replaceable state, never commands/increments/undo. Payload references are immutable by convention; host owns byte budgets and schema. Short sync subscribers; async work goes router. Custom scheduler must defer/cancel/call once; manual rAF uses autoFlush:false. Unsubscribe/AbortSignal/dispose retire listeners/queues/timers and late diagnostics; no replay. Inspect stats before screenshots and verify actual host qualification. createRequestRouter routes operation names to trusted host handlers, not URL navigation/HTTP proxy. Query-only complete-key dedup and opt-in TTL/LRU in one session/tenant scope; dispose/recreate across identity changes. Commands never dedup/cache/retry. Defaults6physical active/128pending/512waiters/128routes/128cache, not rate limiting. Each waiter has own signal/deadline; last cancellation aborts, but ignored-abort physical slots stay occupied until actual settle. Urgent join promotes queued tier without preemption or strict next-first guarantee. Invalidate/unregister/dispose fence late results and old joins; owner invalidation affects all consumers. No auto polling/SWR/replay/exactly-once. Host owns transport, authority, byte budgets, immutable results and recovery. Prefer existing mature query framework; pair with async-boundary for UI lifecycle. Counters/synthetic savings do not prove production capacity/security.
items.evaluation: AG authored contracts, bounded synthetic evidence and host-specific qualification; no real-time/production/backend savings guarantee.

items.title: Иконки по назначению и сетке
items.recommendation: Search existing recognizable icons first. Read design_layout_grids/iconSuitability and grid-<type>. UI icons use keylines/spacing/currentColor and host family; unfamiliar/consequential actions retain labels/native controls/target size. design_icon_draft or createGridIconDraft produces4fixed original starters, not unrestricted text-to-icon AI: purpose/ui24 vs illustrative64, safe literal80UTF16title, bounded primitives/SVG, visible stroke bounds and geometric report. No arbitrary SVG/scripts/resources. Spacing default recipe step2; structural reading/track grids are surrounding layout. Inspect numeric constraints before16/20/24/32px/lightdark/optical/recognition review. A construction hit/currentColor does not certify aesthetics, contrast, AT or originality. Preserve mandatory policies and qualify actual host use. For cinematic/photo framing read design_layout_grids and each wikiSectionId; all14profiles have examples.
items.evaluation: Original bounded drafts and numeric construction evidence, not optical/AT/aesthetic qualification.

items.title: Композиция кадра: кино/фото и локальные сетки
items.recommendation: Discover all14profiles with design_layout_grids and read each wikiSectionId(grid-<type>). Golden Canon remains preferred general creative start, distinct from phi. Cinema edge/lead-room/perspective and photo phi/triangle/diagonal add declared framing choices; points/guides/regions are geometric, never inferred optical subjects or aesthetic certificates. Match purpose, physical units/aspect/side/reflection and nested scope. UI icons use keylines/spacing; read grid-icon-generation and use bounded design_icon_draft before actual-size optical review. Preserve operational/reading/host layouts and current mandatory color/accessibility/security/WebMCP policy.
items.evaluation: Authored templates grounded in source techniques; numerical fit is not professional aesthetic/AT qualification.

items.title: Mesh-градиенты: фон, акцент и читаемый контент
items.recommendation: Read mesh-gradients and related chapters color, color-palettes, motion, creative-direction. Read color, color-palettes and motion. Treat mesh as optional decoration, preserve host semantic roles, inspect worst actual composited backgrounds and provide a stable text surface. Prefer static fallback; do not certify gradients from an opaque average-color pair. Practitioner advice is conditional; current AG policy and host contracts remain authoritative.

items.title: Визуальные акценты без потери иерархии

Solve hierarchy before styling, justify a coherent motif, compare identical content, and preserve functional visual signals. Decorative grids are distinct from composition/debug grids. For visual polish/unslop, read creative-direction (direction card and scope), visual-interest-techniques (product content emphasis) and creative-measurement (location→impact→correction→recheck). Use these conditional craft questions within the existing AG rules, not as aesthetic bans, a new theme or proof of UX quality.

items.title: OpenAI: инструменты, состояние и UI
items.recommendation: Read openai-tool-ui-contract. Keep MCP tools usable headlessly with explicit IDs, outputSchema and structuredContent. Prefer standard MCP Apps for new host integration and feature-detect extensions. Separate authoritative business snapshots, per-instance UI state and durable preferences. Reuse AG async-boundary/event-bus/request-router by their distinct ownership. Test denial, stale results, uncertain writes and negative tool-selection prompts; do not infer success from a click.
items.evaluation: Scoped source-backed guidance; declared numeric checks are advisory, not verified host qualification.

items.title: OpenAI: границы безопасности встроенного UI
items.recommendation: Read openai-embedded-ui-security. Treat tool results and UI content as untrusted. Keep authorization/validation/effects on the server; annotations and hidden controls are not enforcement. Minimize model/browser/log data, distinguish structuredContent from result _meta, validate current CSP/origins and feature-detect sandbox capabilities. Test positive and negative enforcement separately; local UI checks are not security or publication certification.
items.evaluation: Scoped source-backed guidance; declared numeric checks are advisory, not verified host qualification.

items.title: ChatKit: композиция виджетов и списков
items.recommendation: Read chatkit-widget-composition. For ChatKit embeds preserve product theming; do not apply ChatGPT plugin styling limits. Treat builder JSON as a separate versioned contract, map supported types explicitly, and reject unsupported fields. Reuse conversation-card, widget-list, existing controls and common form tracks. AG list limits are not OpenAI standards. Inspect counts/revision/pending before optical review; test stable keys, reorder, removal, RTL, narrow/200% text and themes.
items.evaluation: Source-backed scoped advice; AG mapping is not ChatKit SDK compatibility or automatic conformance.

items.title: ChatKit: адресные действия и область ожидания
items.recommendation: Read chatkit-widget-actions. Separate client intent from authoritative server results. Use actual SDK routing and server validation; keys/revisions are not authorization. ChatKit loadingBehavior defaults are source guidance, while AG widget-list exposes explicit setPending scopes. Test self/container/none, reordered/current-key actions, stale snapshots, denial, uncertain writes and disposal. Keep accepted data visible; do not infer success or retry a write from a button event.
items.evaluation: Source-backed scoped advice; AG mapping is not ChatKit SDK compatibility or automatic conformance.

items.title: ChatKit: компактные формы и явный payload
items.recommendation: Read chatkit-widget-forms. For ChatKit forms verify actual named-field and collision semantics before adapting payloads. Keep authoritative object/revision/operation separate from editable fields; collect only action-relevant values. Reuse AG native form controls and form-row audit. Native required/pattern is not server validation. Test duplicate/conflicting names, keyboard submit, denied writes, retained input and200%text. widget-list does not auto-collect form values or implement ChatKit Form.
items.evaluation: Source-backed scoped advice; AG mapping is not ChatKit SDK compatibility or automatic conformance.

items.title: Чат: компактный ввод и явные инструменты
items.recommendation: Read chat-composer-patterns. For a compact chat reuse agent-conversation with opt-in composerAppearance:compact, visible composerLabel and native multiline/submit semantics. Preserve Enter newline; host shortcuts require IME tests. Only declared composerActions/capabilities render; callbacks carry current sessionId/actionId, not draft/files. Host owns permissions, transport, server authority and effects. Check composerState first, then keyboard/focus, narrow/enlarged text, RTL and themes; test stale errors, unknown send and disposal. field-sizing is progressive enhancement. Public Grok marketing UI is observation, not a live product guarantee.
items.evaluation: Observed public marketing pattern, adapted by AG; not automatic conformance or a runtime guarantee.

items.title: Чат агента: адресат, работа, черновик и результат
items.recommendation: Read agent-work-presentation. Use explicit current recipient/task, per-session drafts and scoped actions. Show observable tool activity and artifacts, not private chain of thought or invented progress. Keep connection/runtime, prepared drafts, accepted sends and completed results distinct. Reuse agent-conversation tool/approval blocks, conversation-card, widget-list and async-boundary; a chat does not implement scheduling, transport or server authority. Test switches, stale results, unknown receipts, bounded history, focus/scroll/drafts. Public Grok Bot marketing sequences do not establish live product guarantees.
items.evaluation: Observed public marketing pattern, adapted by AG; not automatic conformance or a runtime guarantee.

items.title: Три представления чата: документ, переписка и журнал работы
items.recommendation: Choose presentation=document for explanations/research/long answers, messenger for short recipient exchanges, work-log for development/diagnostics/observable operations. Use one agent-conversation model and setPresentation in place; preserve draft, keyed controls, focus/selection, disclosure, pending receipts and follow/read anchor. presentationState is redacted structure only. Fair comparison requires identical messages/states; use chat-comparison shared scenarios, not different content or invented progress. Test narrow/enlarged text, RTL/themes, streams, pending actions and disposal. No view implements delivery, transport, scheduling, private reasoning or server authority.
items.evaluation: AG view-selection guidance. Exact content parity and actual browser checks are separate from consumer qualification.

items.title: Atomic Design: от частей к проверенному экрану
items.recommendation: Read atomic-design-composition. Start from the user task, inventory real components and compose purpose-based patterns/templates; five levels are optional concurrent perspectives, not a factory/folder mandate. Separate shared structure from representative fixture data. Record named slots, pinned children, state/data owner and known direct/reverse dependencies; registered usage is not a complete graph. Recheck affected nested controls and representative screens with current changed_block_review, form-row-layout and component-width-audit scenarios. An isolated component PASS does not certify the page. Preserve host palette, native semantics, qualification and the Pinterest catalog layout. Offline: atomic-design.json; descriptive recipes are not prepare_composition arguments.
items.evaluation: Advisory AG adaptation. No new mandatory gate, auto-lineage computation or Pattern Lab runtime dependency.
